question: Does serializing the lifetime of TrajectoryStore SQLite connections eliminate the reproduced same-process async worker hang?

environment.workers: 2 execute workers, 1 verifier; one producer and one consumer

interpretation_limits: The protocol was locked after initial diagnosis; this is not preregistered research.
One existing bounded-backlog regression is tested on one Apple M1 Pro host.
A timeout indicates the test process did not finish within the external 15 second wall limit.
The candidate lock serializes connections per TrajectoryStore instance; it does not cover multiple instances or multiple processes.
No throughput or production workload claim is made.
